title: Default badge moves to Default's new name only once it is renamed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Make sure Default has its original name, Default.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click Default's row.
  3. Click Default's name at the top of the page.
  4. Type Retail.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  7. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  8. Click Retail's row on the Tiers list.
  9. Click Retail's name at the top of the page.
  10. Type Default.
  11. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Default's row shows the name Default and no Default badge.

Step 2:

  • Default's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name becomes editable in place.

Step 4:

  • The name field reads Retail.

Step 5:

  • The title reads Retail.

Step 6:

  • Row 1 reads Retail with the Default badge beside it.

Step 7:

  • The General Matrix still carries the Default badge.
  • No other matrix carries it.

Step 8:

  • Retail's page opens.

Step 9:

  • The name can be edited.

Step 10:

  • The name field reads Default.

Step 11:

  • The title reads Default again.
